simple.meaning: יְמִינִי (yᵉmîynîy) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 1 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, Ezekiel, beginning at 1 Samuel 9:1. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יְמִינִי (H3227) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows יְמִינִי through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: יְמִינִי (yᵉmîynîy) / H3227 is tracked through 1 Samuel 9:1, 1 Samuel 9:4, 1 Samuel 22:7, 1 Chronicles 27:12. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

timeline.evidenceText: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah, the son of a Benjamite, a mighty man of valor.

He passed through the hill country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they didn’t find them. Then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and they weren’t there. Then he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they didn’t find them.

Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you fields and vineyards? Will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds,
The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
“Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.
